slides.name: Title
slides.title: Open Document Skills
body: Programmatic OpenDocument authoring — ODT, ODP, ODS, ODG
Pure Python. No office suite required for edits.

slides.name: Capabilities
slides.title: What it does
body: Generate documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and drawings
Footnotes, citations, cross-references, and MathML formulas
Charts, named ranges, animations, transitions, and diagrams
Flat-ODF Git diffs and OASIS ODF 1.3 schema validation

slides.name: Workflow
slides.title: How it works
body: Each skill is a folder of small, composable Python scripts
Edits operate directly on the ODF XML — fast and inspectable
LibreOffice is optional, used only to render previews
